market_sources.name: Import and export users and customers
WooCommerce Product CSV Importer and Exporter
OWASP XML External Entity Prevention Cheat Sheet

records.label: Overview Cards (Recent / Failed / Scheduled / Conflicts / Adapters / Temp Space)
records.notes: Recent imports/exports, failed/partial runs, scheduled runs, unresolved mapping conflicts, adapters needing attention and storage/temp-space health are computed summaries; counts only, no source row content or PII. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2, §3.

records.label: Quick Actions
records.notes: Import/Export WPE package, New Data Import/Export and View failed rows each route to their own wizard with capability checks; no quick action executes a write directly. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3.

records.label: Package Scope Selector (All / Suites / Modules / Definitions)
records.notes: Selection by suite, module or individual definition through stable UUIDs; Export All builds a Configuration Package only and never implicitly bundles runtime data. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Scope selector; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Package types.

records.label: Dependency Closure (Required On / Optional Explicit / External Reference)
records.notes: Include transitive hard dependencies by default; optional dependencies explicit; external references recorded in the manifest; excluding a hard dependency requires an impact preview and the importer never creates dangling hard dependencies. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Scope selector; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Dependency closure modes.

records.label: Package Name / Description / Environment Label
records.notes: Human title, description and environment/source label are optional manifest metadata; source site-identifying metadata is minimized by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Options; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Root manifest candidate.

records.label: Include Revisions (Current / Published + Current / Selected History)
records.notes: Current only is default; history export is explicit and bounded. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Options; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Revisions and rollback.

records.label: Include Inactive / Archived Definitions
records.notes: Off by default; included definitions keep their exported status and never activate on import implicitly. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Options.

records.label: Include Module Settings
records.notes: Only settings their owner marks portable; environment-specific settings (URLs, paths, caches) are excluded or placeholdered. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Options.

records.label: Include Local UI Preferences (Explicitly Portable Only)
records.notes: Only preferences the owner marks portable are offered; per-user state is never exported by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Options.

records.label: Include Non-Secret Connection Definitions
records.notes: Exports provider/type, non-secret settings and required scopes consistent with the Surface 23 Connections Bank (connections.portability.import-export); credentials never leave the Vault. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Options; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Secrets behavior.

records.label: Credential Placeholders (Default On When Referenced)
records.notes: Typed secret slot/reference placeholders replace every credential; import marks the connection credential_required until an admin binds a local Vault secret. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Options; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Secrets behavior.

records.label: Export Preflight (Graph / Broken / Pro / Schema / Size / Secrets Excluded)
records.notes: Dependency graph, missing/broken definitions, Pro-module definitions, unsupported schema versions, estimated size and a secrets-excluded summary are shown before the package is written. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Preflight.

records.label: Versioned Manifest (Format / Version / UUID / Type / Product + Platform API Version)
records.notes: manifest.json carries format, format_version, package UUID, package type, created-at UTC, source product and Platform API versions, module requirements and secret policy; runtime-data inclusion is false for definition packages. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Output; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Root manifest candidate.

records.label: Stable UUID Identity (No Local Numeric IDs)
records.notes: Definitions reference each other by stable UUID/key; local DB primary keys are never portable identity. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Output; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Definition record format.

records.label: Per-Artifact and Package Checksums
records.notes: Checksums detect accidental or tampered content but do not establish author trust. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Output; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Integrity.

records.label: Dependency Edges + Circular Dependency Validation
records.notes: Circular dependencies are a validation error unless the domain explicitly supports a safe mutually-referential import sequence. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4 Output; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Dependency closure modes.

records.label: Package Types (Definition / Blueprint / Full Configuration)
records.notes: Definition, Blueprint and Full WPE Configuration packages exclude runtime data and secrets by default; Runtime Data Export is a separate engine/artifact. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Package types.

records.label: Container Safety (ZIP + UTF-8 JSON, No Executable Payload)
records.notes: Candidate ZIP container with UTF-8 JSON manifests/definitions and optional safe static assets only; no executable PHP/JS; archive traversal and bomb protections on import. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Container.

records.label: Portable Assets (UUID / MIME / Size / Checksum / License)
records.notes: Only assets necessary for the definition and safe to redistribute; paid theme/plugin/vendor assets without redistribution rights are never packaged. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Assets.

records.label: Personal / Runtime Data Excluded From Definition Packages
records.notes: Users, entries, chat, enrollments, runs, audit logs, notification history, backup archives, custom-table rows and field values are excluded; blueprint sample data must be marked sample_data and contain no production personal data. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Personal/runtime data.

records.label: Import Pipeline (Inspect → Verify → Compatibility → Dependencies → Conflicts → Map → Dry Run → Approval → Import → Validate → Report)
records.notes: No step writes before approval; each step is resumable from the report, and the dry run reuses the Surface 10 Dashboard Widgets preset portability pattern of snapshot, preflight and mapping before apply. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Steps; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Import pipeline.

records.label: Package Source (Upload / Server Library / Connection Storage / URL via Connections)
records.notes: URL import only through Surface 23 Connections Safe HTTP/SSRF policy, never arbitrary file_get_contents(); uploads go to private non-executable storage. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Source.

records.label: Structure / Checksum / Schema Verification
records.notes: Malformed manifests, checksum mismatch and schema violations stop the run before analysis; all package content is treated as untrusted input. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Steps; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Integrity.

records.label: Version Compatibility (Older Migrate / Current / Future Inspect-Only)
records.notes: Supported older schemas migrate through accepted migrators; unknown future schemas are inspect/report only with no lossy downgrade. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Conflict statuses; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Version compatibility.

records.label: Conflict Statuses
records.notes: exact existing UUID/revision, update available, local newer, same UUID divergent history, key/slug collision with different UUID, dependency missing, module unavailable, Pro on Free-only site and unsupported newer schema are explicit classes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Conflict statuses; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Conflict classes.

records.label: Per-Definition Resolution (Skip / Update / Clone / Map / Defer / Abort)
records.notes: Destructive replace is never a hidden default; key collision never assumes identity; replace only when the target is WPE-owned and impact permits. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Resolution per definition; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Conflict classes.

records.label: Semantic Diff With High-Impact Highlighting
records.notes: Diff on normalized schema fields, not raw JSON lines; security/visibility/capability changes are highlighted separately. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Steps; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Semantic diff.

records.label: Conflict Center Grouping + Row Detail
records.notes: Groups Safe/Create/Update/Rename/Map/Missing dependency/Credential required/Lossy/Unsupported; each row shows source, target candidate, reason, diff summary, dependency impact, action and severity. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Conflict UX.

records.label: Bulk Decisions Only for Homogeneous Safe Conflicts
records.notes: Rename-all-collisions may be offered; overwrite-all is never a default safe action. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Conflict UX.

records.label: Import Modes (Create-Only / Sync-Update / Clone New Identity / Deferred)
records.notes: Create-only never mutates matched targets; clone rewrites internal references to new UUIDs; sync/update applies only to same-source/same-UUID definitions with revision safeguards. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Import modes.

records.label: Free-Only Site Pro Definition Handling
records.notes: Pro definitions stay visible in the report and may be stored as deferred/read-only package records only if architecture permits; never silently discarded or falsely activated. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5 Free-only site behavior; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Version compatibility.

records.label: Credential Required State After Import
records.notes: Imported connections/plans stay disabled or degraded until an admin binds a new Vault reference, matching Surface 23 and Surface 24 Bank portability decisions. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Secrets behavior, Conflict classes.

records.label: Revision Preservation + Batch ID
records.notes: Updating a definition preserves its current revision, writes a new revision and records the package/batch ID for rollback. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Revisions and rollback.

records.label: Package Import History
records.notes: Package UUID, source version, actor, decisions, counts and result are retained as audit-safe history without secret or personal payloads. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Import history.

records.label: Data Imports List Columns
records.notes: Name, target, source format, mode, schedule, last run/result, rows processed/failed, source, updated, health and actions. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6 Columns.

records.label: Row Actions (Edit / Run / Dry Run / Preview / Duplicate / Runs / Export Definition / Pause / Archive)
records.notes: Run always routes through preflight and the confirmation policy of its mode; Duplicate copies definition only; delete is archive-first. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6 Actions.

records.label: Name / Stable Key / Description / Status / Tags
records.notes: Name required, stable key, Draft/Enabled/Paused/Archived status; only Enabled definitions run on schedule. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Source Type (CSV / JSON / XML / XLSX / Sheets / REST / WPE Adapter / Certified Migration Adapter)
records.notes: Google Sheets and remote REST only through certified Connections providers; source-plugin migration only through certified adapters. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Target Data Source / Entity via Data Source Registry
records.notes: Posts/CPTs, users, terms, comments/media where supported, custom tables and owner-module importers; never direct writes to another module's private tables. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16.

records.label: Upload Size / MIME / Extension Checks
records.notes: Max size bounded by server and module policy; MIME + extension + content sniffing via wp_check_filetype_and_ext() substrate. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Compressed Source (ZIP / GZIP) With Safe Archive Limits
records.notes: Entry count, ratio, total bytes and path traversal limits; nested archives rejected. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Private Non-Executable Storage + Retention
records.notes: Import files stored outside public executable paths with one-shot vs saved retention and cleanup schedule. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §51.

records.label: Encoding Detection / Selection
records.notes: UTF-8 default with approved encodings; invalid byte sequences reported per row. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9, §10.

records.label: Delimiter (Comma / Semicolon / Tab / Pipe / Custom One Character)
records.notes: Custom delimiter bounded to one character; RFC 4180 quoting semantics. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Header Row Yes/No + Row Number
records.notes: Preview shows parsed columns before mapping. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Quote / Enclosure + Escape Semantics
records.notes: Escape semantics follow the selected parser; never ad-hoc splitting. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Trim BOM / Skip Empty Lines (Default On)
records.notes: Comment rows only with explicit syntax. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Row Start / Limit for Testing
records.notes: Bounded test window; never alters the saved full-run range silently. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Root Path / Collection Selector + Object vs Array Validation
records.notes: Controlled selector grammar; missing path behavior explicit. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Maximum Depth / Items per Object
records.notes: Depth and item caps enforced while streaming. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Flatten Preview
records.notes: Preview only; mapping still targets explicit paths. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Record Element / Path + Namespaces + Attribute/Text Extraction
records.notes: Namespace mappings declared explicitly. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: XXE / External Entity / DTD Disabled + Depth Limits
records.notes: External entity expansion disabled and external DTD/resources never fetched, per the OWASP XXE Prevention Cheat Sheet. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Sheet / Header / Start Row / Date Serial + Timezone / Merged-Cell Warning
records.notes: Parser/library choice remains technical evidence work. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Cached Values Only; Macros Never Executed
records.notes: Evaluated cached value only; spreadsheet macros never run. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Connection + Request Profile (No Secrets in Definition)
records.notes: Remote API source uses a Surface 23 Connection; secrets are never typed into the import definition. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Pagination (Page / Cursor / Next-Link) + Collection Path + Item ID
records.notes: Provider adapter strategy; bounded page count per run. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Rate / Retry Profile + Incremental Watermark
records.notes: Backpressure owned by Connections; recurring cursor sync remains Surface 41. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14, §56.

records.label: Bounded Source Preview / Profiling
records.notes: Fields/paths, candidate types, null/empty counts, duplicate key samples, parse issues, encoding warnings, media URL fields and nested collections from a bounded sample. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Type Inference Is Suggestion Only
records.notes: Administrator confirms every target mapping. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Create Only / Update Only / Upsert / Synchronize
records.notes: Synchronize is high-impact because missing source rows can change or delete target records; Create Only is the default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §17.

records.label: Match Key (Slug / Email / External ID / Custom / Composite / Adapter Identity)
records.notes: WordPress ID only for same-environment controlled imports with a non-portable warning; email matching under privacy constraints. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18.

records.label: Match One/All Parts + Case Sensitivity + Trim/Normalize
records.notes: Follows target semantics. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18.

records.label: Preflight Non-Unique Target Key Detection
records.notes: Run blocked when the target key is not unique. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18.

records.label: Duplicate Source Rows (Fail Default / First / Last / Explicit Merge)
records.notes: Fail duplicates is the safest default; row numbers reported. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §19.

records.label: Mapping Row (Source / Target / Types / Transforms / Required / Null Policy / Applicability / Default / Validation)
records.notes: Mapping uses target Field/Data Source schema; no arbitrary mass assignment. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §20.

records.label: Missing / Empty / Null Semantics (Ignore Default)
records.notes: Missing source ignores target by default; zero/false never confused with empty; preview shows examples because silent clearing is dangerous. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §21.

records.label: Allowlisted Typed Transform Pipeline
records.notes: trim, case, casts, date/timezone, split/join, exact replace, prefix/suffix, enum map, bounded JSON decode, HTML sanitize, phone/email/URL normalize, lookup and registered SDK transforms; reusable engine delegated to Surface 45 where shared. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §22.

records.label: Before/After Sample per Transform
records.notes: Every transform shows a bounded sample. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §22.

records.label: Bounded Regex Replace
records.notes: Only after security/performance review with time and length bounds. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §22.

records.label: Taxonomy Mapping (Delimiter / Slug-Name / Create Missing / Hierarchy / Replace-Append-Leave)
records.notes: Term ID mapping only same-site; creating terms requires capability and validates hierarchy cycles. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §23.

records.label: Relations Mapping via Relation Engine
records.notes: Relation definition, related identity, one/many, replace/append and missing-target error/skip/defer second pass; never raw serialized meta. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24.

records.label: Batch / Deferred Relation Linking
records.notes: Large many-to-many imports link in a bounded second pass. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24, §56.

records.label: Remote Media Download Through SSRF Policy
records.notes: Allowed schemes/hosts, private-network block, max bytes, timeout and MIME allowlist; remote URL never bypasses Safe HTTP/file checks. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §25.

records.label: Filename Strategy / Dimension Policy / Duplicate Match / Featured / Gallery / Alt-Caption Mapping
records.notes: Duplicate match by checksum, source URL or external ID. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §25.

records.label: Email / Username / Display Name / Allowlisted Meta
records.notes: User meta only through an allowlist. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §26.

records.label: Initial Role Allowlist (Low Privilege)
records.notes: Administrator-equivalent roles require a dedicated high-risk permission and migration evidence; role truth stays Surface 30. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §26, §52.

records.label: Send Account / Reset Notification
records.notes: Explicit opt-in; delivery owned by Notifications (Surface 19). Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §26.

records.label: No Plaintext Password Import by Default
records.notes: Users get reset links; hashes only through certified same-system migration where compatible and explicitly supported. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §26.

records.label: Status Allowlist / Dates / Author Lookup / Slug / Parent / Comment-Ping Status
records.notes: Invalid status or capability falls back or errors per policy; never silently publishes private content. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §27.

records.label: Missing Source Records (Do Nothing Default / Trash / Delete / Set Value / Detach)
records.notes: Do nothing is the safest default; permanent delete is exceptional high-risk with dedicated capability. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §28.

records.label: Sync Manages Only Records Owned by This Import
records.notes: Widening scope requires explicit administrator action with high warning. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §28.

records.label: Ownership Marker (Import UUID / Source Item ID / Source Hash / Timestamps)
records.notes: Used for deterministic re-import, missing-record sync and conflict detection. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §29.

records.label: Local Change Conflict Policy (Source Wins / Target Wins / Per-Field / Report and Skip)
records.notes: Exact detection via stored source fingerprint plus target revision where available; report-and-skip is the managed-sync safe candidate. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §30.

records.label: Dry Run Before First Destructive Import
records.notes: Required before destructive runs, strongly encouraged otherwise; writes no target runtime data except temporary analysis records cleaned by retention. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §31.

records.label: Dry Run Counts (Create / Update / Unchanged / Skip / Conflict / Errors / Relations / Media / Deletes / Sensitive Changes)
records.notes: Role/status sensitive changes are listed explicitly. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §31.

records.label: Source Changed Since Preview Detection
records.notes: Source checksum and mapping revision fingerprints invalidate a stale dry run. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §33, §55.

records.label: Abort on Error Count / Percentage / Continue Valid / Stop on First
records.notes: Destructive sync defaults to abort when preflight has unresolved mapping or identity errors. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §32.

records.label: Batch Size Auto (Default) / Bounded Manual + Maximum Cap
records.notes: Memory/time diagnostics shown; manual size bounded by settings cap. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §33, §51.

records.label: Checkpoint (Cursor / Processed / Source Checksum / Mapping Revision)
records.notes: Resume only when source/mapping compatibility still matches; changed source requires a new run. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §33.

records.label: Import Run States
records.notes: queued, analyzing, dry_running, waiting_confirmation, importing, linking_relations, processing_media, finalizing, completed, completed_with_errors, failed, cancelled, rollback_available, rolled_back. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §34.

records.label: Bounded Per-Row Result
records.notes: Source item ID, safe target reference, action, status, error codes and changed-field keys only; full PII source rows not persisted by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §35.

records.label: Failed-Row Export With Privacy Controls
records.notes: Source data in failed-row exports requires dedicated capability and privacy policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §35, §52.

records.label: Rollback Strategies (Delete Created / Restore Snapshot / Untrash / Undo Relations)
records.notes: Only for changes WPE recorded sufficiently; later local edits make automatic rollback dangerous and are warned. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §36.

records.label: Rollback Coverage % + Limitations Shown Before Import
records.notes: External side effects, emails, provider calls and downloaded media may not be reversible. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §36.

records.label: Backup Restore Point Integration for High-Impact Sync
records.notes: Recommended or required for high-impact sync; restore-point truth is Surface 24 Backup. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §36; docs/PRODUCT/IMPORT-EXPORT-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Canonical ownership decisions.

records.label: Scheduled Imports via Cron/Job Service
records.notes: Persistent Connection/path source only, overlap skip/queue, dry-run-only schedules, failure threshold pause and failure notification; executes on Surface 18. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §37.

records.label: Schedule Pins Published Import Revision
records.notes: Mapping changes never mutate an already-running run. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §37.

records.label: Data Exports List Columns + Actions
records.notes: Name, source/query, format, destination, schedule, last run/result, rows/bytes, updated; Download latest only if authorized. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §38.

records.label: Export Source (Data Source / Query Builder / Admin List Snapshot / Selected Records)
records.notes: Query/source policy checked server-side; object-level read permission enforced per record. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §39.

records.label: Export Field Mapping (Column / Token / Formatter / Default / Privacy Class / Relation Flattening)
records.notes: Each field carries a privacy classification; PII is redacted or masked per policy unless the actor holds export-sensitive-data capability. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §40.

records.label: Sensitive Field Capability Gate
records.notes: Sensitive fields require additional capability; P3 secrets are unavailable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §40, §52.

records.label: Passwords / Hashes / Application Passwords / Tokens Never Exportable
records.notes: Never offered as generic export fields in any mode. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §40; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Secrets behavior.

records.label: CSV Format Settings (Delimiter / Quote / Header / UTF-8 / Line Ending / Optional BOM)
records.notes: BOM optional for spreadsheet compatibility. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §41.

records.label: JSON Array / NDJSON + Pretty Print Off for Large Output
records.notes: NDJSON candidate for large data. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §41.

records.label: XML Safe Element Names / XLSX Sheet + Column Formats
records.notes: XLSX through a reviewed writer only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §41.

records.label: Spreadsheet Formula Injection Protection (Default On)
records.notes: Cells starting with =, +, -, @, tab or CR are escaped per OWASP CSV Injection guidance; raw output only via explicit trusted developer mode. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §42, §51.

records.label: Destination (Download / Private File / Backup Storage / Connection / Secure Link Email)
records.notes: Remote destinations reuse Backup storage or Connections adapters; credentials remain Vault-managed; email sends a secure link, not a large attachment. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §43.

records.label: Filename Template Tokens (Allowlisted, Traversal-Safe)
records.notes: Tokens sanitized via sanitize_file_name() substrate; no path segments. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §44.

records.label: Compression / Split / Retention / Overwrite (Never / Version / Explicit Replace)
records.notes: Overwrite never is default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §44.

records.label: Archive Encryption via Reviewed Backup Contract Only
records.notes: Reuses the Surface 24 encryption contract; no ad-hoc password ZIP. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §44.

records.label: Incremental Export (Watermark / Cursor / Tombstones / Checkpoint)
records.notes: Only when the source supports a stable cursor; never claims complete incremental sync when deletes are undetectable. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §45.

records.label: Bounded Export Preview With Masking / Redaction
records.notes: Shows transformed output, masking/redaction, estimated rows/size and query warnings; never the full export in browser memory. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §46.

records.label: Export Run States + Destination Verification Tier
records.notes: queued, querying, writing, compressing/encrypting, uploading, verifying destination, completed, completed_with_warnings, failed, cancelled, pruned; completed means the selected verification tier, not only HTTP success. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §47.

records.label: Scheduled Exports via Cron/Job Service
records.notes: Overlap and failure policy as imports; executes on Surface 18. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §38, §37.

records.label: Mapping Templates (Name / Source Schema Fingerprint / Target Schema / Mappings / Defaults / Match Policy)
records.notes: Saved only when source and target schema identities are compatible. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §48.

records.label: Template Applied to Changed Source Shows Invalid / Missing Mappings
records.notes: Never silently shifts columns by position. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §48.

records.label: Source Product / Version Detection + Certified Range
records.notes: Detection confidence shown; uncertified versions are inspect-only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §49; docs/ARCHITECTURE/SOURCE-MIGRATION-ADAPTER-REGISTRY.md Detection confidence, Version support policy.

records.label: Domains Supported / Fidelity Summary / Lossy Items / Migration Order
records.notes: Lossy and unsupported items are listed before mapping. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §49; docs/ARCHITECTURE/SOURCE-MIGRATION-ADAPTER-REGISTRY.md Adapter capabilities.

records.label: Adapter Maps to Neutral IR / Import Service Only
records.notes: Adapters never write the target DB directly and never execute source-provided callbacks/code. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §49; docs/ARCHITECTURE/SOURCE-MIGRATION-ADAPTER-REGISTRY.md Mapper contract, Security.

records.label: Source Deactivation Verification
records.notes: Counts/identities compared and live dependencies listed; never claims safe to deactivate unless fidelity checks pass; source untouched by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §50.

records.label: Temp Directory + Temp File Retention
records.notes: Private non-executable temp location with low-space monitoring. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §51, §56.

records.label: Max Upload Bytes (Bounded by Server)
records.notes: Never exceeds server limits. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §51.

records.label: Default Batch Size Auto + Maximum Batch Cap
records.notes: Caps bound manual batch sizes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §51.

records.label: Run History / Failed Row / Source File / Export File Retention
records.notes: Bounded retention; failed-row data with PII purged on schedule. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §51.

records.label: Default Encoding
records.notes: UTF-8 default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §51.

records.label: Remote Download Max Bytes + Media Timeout/Size
records.notes: Bounded defaults. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §51.

records.label: Spreadsheet Formula Protection On
records.notes: Default on; disabling requires trusted developer mode. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §42, §51.

records.label: Scheduled Import Failure Pause Threshold
records.notes: Pauses after N consecutive failures and notifies. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §37, §51.

records.label: Privacy Logging Level
records.notes: Minimal by default; logs never contain secret values or full PII rows. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §35, §51.

records.label: Separate Capabilities (Read / Edit / Dry Run / Execute / Destructive Sync / Rollback / PII Rows / Sensitive Export / Users-Roles / Schedules / Packages)
records.notes: Every write request requires capability plus nonce (current_user_can()/check_admin_referer() substrate). Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §52.

records.label: High-Risk Capability + Re-Auth for Destructive Sync / Admin-Equivalent Changes
records.notes: Dedicated capability and recent re-authentication. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §52.

records.label: Import / Export / Run / Package / Template / Adapter Abilities
records.notes: list/get/create/update/validate/preview/dry-run/run/cancel/rollback with Policy checks. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §53.

records.label: AI Default: Analyze / Preview / Mapping Suggestions / Dry-Run Explanation Only
records.notes: No destructive import, sync, rollback or sensitive export by AI by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §53.

records.label: Run / Package / Migration / Schedule Pause Events
records.notes: Aggregated run events; no per-row workflow event by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §54.

records.label: Error / Degraded States
records.notes: source changed, schema stale, encoding, malformed, adapter unsupported, dependency missing, low disk, media blocked, relation missing, permission denied, rate limit, checkpoint corrupted, rollback partial; Pro expiry makes definitions read-only and pauses mutating schedules safely. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §55.

records.label: Streaming Parsers/Writers + Chunked Writes + Batched Lookups
records.notes: No full large file in memory, no N+1 lookups, async large runs, temp disk monitoring. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §56.

records.label: Keyboard Mapping Table + Text Progress + Focus-Safe Errors
records.notes: Assets only on Import/Export screens; bounded polling via shared job UI. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §57.

records.label: Per-Site Scope; Network Users Only With Network Capability
records.notes: switch_to_blog()/is_multisite() substrate; no cross-site import by default. Evidence: docs/PRODUCT/IMPORT-EXPORT-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Native WordPress audit required before Bank review.

records.label: Audit Trail of Imports / Exports / Packages
records.notes: Actor, definition revision, source fingerprint, counts and result; no secret values or PII payloads. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §54; docs/PRODUCT/IMPORT-EXPORT-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Candidate Bank families 24.

records.label: All Imported Content Treated as Untrusted
records.notes: Schema validation, size limits and full validation whether or not a package is signed. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Integrity; docs/PRODUCT/IMPORT-EXPORT-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Rejected-unsafe / bounded candidates.

records.label: JSON-Only Payloads; No PHP Object Deserialization
records.notes: Package and data payloads are parsed as JSON/CSV/XML only; serialized PHP strings are treated as opaque text and never passed to unserialize()/maybe_unserialize(). Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Container; docs/PRODUCT/IMPORT-EXPORT-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md Rejected-unsafe / bounded candidates.

records.label: Posts / CPTs via wp_insert_post() / wp_update_post()
records.notes: Native hooks, sanitization and capability semantics; no raw SQL writes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16, §27.

records.label: Meta via update_post_meta() / register_meta()
records.notes: Registered meta with sanitize callbacks; arbitrary meta keys only through allowlist. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §20, §26.

records.label: Terms via wp_insert_term() / wp_set_object_terms()
records.notes: Native term creation and relationship replace/append. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §23.

records.label: Users via wp_insert_user() + is_email() / sanitize_user()
records.notes: Native user creation; passwords set by wp_hash_password() only from reset flows. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §26.

records.label: Media via download_url() / media_handle_sideload() / wp_safe_remote_get()
records.notes: Safe HTTP rejects private/local hosts via wp_http_validate_url(); set_post_thumbnail() for featured images. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §25.

records.label: Uploads via wp_handle_upload() / wp_check_filetype_and_ext()
records.notes: Real MIME/extension validation; private directory under wp_upload_dir() with deny rules. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Archive Extraction via unzip_file() + WPE Limits
records.notes: WP_Filesystem extraction wrapped with entry/ratio/path limits. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Container.

records.label: wp_unique_post_slug() / wp_generate_uuid4()
records.notes: Collision-safe slugs and stable UUID generation for portable identity. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Definition record format.

records.label: WXR Export / Import (export_wp() + WordPress Importer)
records.notes: Native content export/import is the parity baseline for posts/terms/comments/authors; WPE adds mapping, dry run and ownership markers. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8, §16.

records.label: Personal Data Exporters (wp_privacy_personal_data_exporters)
records.notes: Privacy export/erasure tooling remains the GDPR path; Import/Export is not an erasure workflow. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §35, §40.

records.label: wp_schedule_event() Substrate for Scheduled Runs
records.notes: Execution owned by Surface 18 Job Service. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §37.

records.label: wp_kses_post() HTML Sanitize Transform
records.notes: Used by the HTML sanitize transform. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §22.

records.label: wp_json_encode() Output Encoding
records.notes: Safe JSON encoding for packages/exports. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §41; docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Container.

records.label: WP-CLI export / import Commands
records.notes: Developer precedent; WPE CLI parity is a later Abilities surface, not a bypass of preflight. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §53.

records.label: Signed Package Provenance (Publisher Identity)
records.notes: Optional future signing establishes publisher trust; unsigned packages are still allowed but fully validated; requires separate key/distribution policy. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Integrity, Official Blueprint Registry — future.

records.label: Official Blueprint Registry
records.notes: Signed publisher metadata, changelog and minimum requirements. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Official Blueprint Registry — future.

records.label: Security-Classified Semantic Diff

records.label: Pre-Run Rollback Coverage Percentage
records.notes: Market importers rarely quantify rollback coverage before execution. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §36.

records.label: Encrypted Secret Transfer Mode
records.notes: Requires separate ADR/threat model; secrets excluded until then. Evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md Secrets behavior.

records.label: Concurrent Import Workers
records.notes: Only after idempotency/locking proof. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §33.

records.notes: Rejected: imported code is never executed. Evidence: docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8, §22.

coverage.notes: All 188 Import/Export records are classified from docs/MODULES/IMPORT-EXPORT-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE/PORTABLE-CONFIGURATION-PACKAGE-FORMAT.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE/SOURCE-MIGRATION-ADAPTER-REGISTRY.md and docs/PRODUCT/IMPORT-EXPORT-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md (142 WPE_HARD, 11 NATIVE_HARD, 3 SOFT_NATIVE, 4 WPE_EXCEED, 6 DEFERRED and 22 REJECTED_UNSAFE). Native post/term/user/meta/media/upload/archive/Safe HTTP/privacy/cron primitives are write substrate only; every import treats content as untrusted (schema validation, size limits, JSON-only payloads with no PHP object deserialization or code execution, private non-executable storage, no arbitrary file write) and runs preflight, dry run and mapping preview behind capability + nonce, while exports exclude secrets/credentials by default and redact PII per privacy classification; 6 items are deferred and 22 unsafe patterns stay rejected.
